07:00

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
RECESS SPECIAL CITY COUNCIL MEETING AND SPECIAL COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION MEETING
PRESENTATIONS
MOMENT OF SILENCE IN REMEMBRANCE OF ALL THE PEOPLE WHO LOST THEIR LIVES ON SEPTEMBER 11, 2001
MOMENT OF SILENCE IN REMEMBRANCE OF ALL THE PEOPLE WHO LOST THEIR LIVES ON SEPTEMBER 11, 2001
INTRODUCTION OF NEW STAFF MEMBERS
PRESENTATION OF PROCLAMATION PROCLAIMING SEPTEMBER 23, 2007 THROUGH SEPTEMBER 29, 2007, AS CHILDHOOD INJURY PREVENTION WEEK
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING TO ADOPT A RESOLUTION APPROVING AN AGREEMENT WITH CHEVRON ENERGY SOLUTIONS FOR THE DESIGN/RENOVATION OF THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER AND THE DESIGN/CONSTRUCTION OF THE LA PUENTE YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER AND APPROVAL OF FINANCING
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing; (2) take oral testimony and close the public hearing; (3) adopt the resolution authorizing the Mayor to enter into an Energy Services Contract with Chevron Energy Solutions to perform Design/Renovation of the La Puente Community Center and the Design/Construction of the La Puente Youth Learning Activity Center; and (4) approve financing for the construction thereof.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING RESOLUTION 07-4643 AND APPOINTMENT OF PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSIONERS
It is recommended that the City Council amend Resolution 07-4643 to reflect the City Council’s decision regarding the total amount of Commissioners and/or alternates; and appoint a fifth Commissioner with the remaining three (3) applicants as alternates.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1210 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
D-2
APPROVAL OF NEW PARTICIPANT(S) FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION (D97301-08) - FISCAL YEAR 2007-08
The Screening Commission recommends that the City Council approve the allocations and authorize the Assistant City Manager to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $17,000.
D-3
SECOND READING - EXTENSION OF ORDINANCE NO. 06-856 EXTENDING THE TERMS AND PROVISIONS OF URGENCY ORDINANCE NO. O6-853 - PROHIBITING ESTABLISHMENT OR OPERATION OF "SMOKE SHOPS" IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE (Introduced and title read at meeting of August 28, 2007)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the ordinance extending Ordinance No. 06-856 for an additional year.
D-4
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR PURCHASE OF A NEW 2007 CHEVROLET SILVERADO 2500 HD CLASSIC 2WD FOR THE MAINTENANCE SUPERVISOR
It is recommended that the City Council authorize Staff to solicit bids for the purchase of a new 2007 Chevrolet Silverado 2500 HD Classic 2WD Regular Cab 133" Work Truck and designate Tuesday, October 16, 2007 at 10:00 a.m. as the deadline for receiving bids.
D-5
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR PURCHASE OF A NEW 2007 FORD ESCAPE HYBRID FWD FOR THE PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR
It is recommended that the City Council authorize Staff to solicit bids for the purchase of a new 2007 Ford Escape Hybrid FWD and designate Tuesday, October 16, 2007 at 11:00 a.m. as the deadline for receiving bids.
D-6
BID AWARD: LOCAL STREET RESURFACING (AMAR, PUENTE, TONOPAH) PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council award the contract for the construction portion of the Local Street Resurfacing (Amar, Puente, Tonopah) Project to Silvia Construction.
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING THE 2007-2008 BUDGET TO INCLUDE THE COSTS FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM (CIP) TO BE FUNDED UNDER THE SEWER ENTERPRISE FUND AND TO AMEND FUNDING SOURCES OF ALL STREET IMPROVEMENTS CIP PROJECTS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution approving the City's updated Capital Improvement Projects and amend the budget to include the costs for the projects in the City's 2007/2008 Fiscal Year Budget.
D-8
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR TEMPLE AVENUE STREET IMPROVEMENT PROJECT FROM GLENDORA AVENUE TO STIMSON AVENUE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the specifications; and (2) authorize Staff to solicit bids for the Temple Avenue Street Improvement Project from Glendora Avenue to Stimson Avenue.
D-9
AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR THE INSTALLATION OF AN AUDIO/VISUAL SYSTEM FOR THE SENIOR CENTER IMPROVEMENTS PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council award the bid to Western Audio Visual Corporation in the amount of $23,809.40 and authorize the Mayor to execute the Agreement with Western Audio Visual Corporation for installation of the Audio/Visual system at the Senior Center.
ITEM PULLED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR SEPARATE CONSIDERATION
D-5
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR PURCHASE OF A NEW 2007 FORD ESCAPE HYBRID FWD FOR THE PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF INTRODUCTION OF AN ORDINANCE INCREASING COUNCIL MEMBERS’ SALARIES PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 36516
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) read the ordinance by title only and waive further reading; and (2) introduce the ordinance for subsequent adoption.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF FORMATION OF LA PUENTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Resolution authorizing Execution and Delivery of a Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement with the La Puente Community Development Commission, Establishing the La Puente Public Financing Authority.
E-3
REQUEST TO CONSTRUCT A MONUMENT IN HONOR OF ALL LOCAL VETERANS FROM EVERY BRANCH OF THE SERVICE ON THE TRIANGLE PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE ENTRANCE OF CENTRAL AVENUE AND ABBEY STREET (Requested by Council Member Solis)
None.
RECESS CITY COUNCIL AND CONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
AGENDA
SPECIAL MEETING
LA PUENTE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
SEPTEMBER 11, 2007 at 7:00 P.M.
ROLL CALL
COMMISSIONERS: Solis, Storing, Lujan, Perez, Chavez
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
During oral communications, if you wish to address the Redevelopment Agency Board during this Special Meeting, under Government Code Section 54954.3(a), you may only address the Board concerning any item that has been described in the notice for the special meeting. Please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the Agency Secretary no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
None.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF REVISED LEASE AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT WITH ED BUTTS FORD, INC. FOR PROPOSED EXPANSION AT 1529-45 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the Community Development Commission: (1) take additional public testimony; and (2) continue the public hearing to September 25, 2007.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Commission, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of Commission. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
None.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF FORMATION OF LA PUENTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
It is recommended the Community Development Commission adopt the Resolution authorizing Execution and Delivery of a Joint Exercise of Powers Agreement with the City of La Puente, Establishing the La Puente Public Financing Authority.
RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL
